answer: Treat new identities like saplings in an orchard: rewards vest only after an account has grown a long, unbroken thread of graded work across many epochs, each graded by randomly drawn, already-vested peers. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand fresh keys gets a thousand empty threads and nothing spendable until each one independently survives review. Unvested balances can be slashed when peers catch copied answers, so a rising tide of fake accounts drains the attacker's stake instead of lifting their share.
